dict_txt.source: Filtered from upstream ipa_metadata.json keys with source=wiktionary or source=manual; exact upstream dict order retained
dict_txt.excluded: All keys whose source is generated or unknown

ipa_json.source: Filtered from upstream ipa.json using per-entry source labels in ipa_metadata.json
ipa_json.wiktionary_license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 and GFDL as documented by Wiktionary/Kaikki

fallback.package_release_evidence: PyPI TLTK 1.3.8 metadata states BSD-3-Clause; PyPI project description says BSD-3-Clause since 1.2.2
fallback.source_repository_conflict: attapol/tltk repository currently contains LICENSE (LGPL-3.0) and LICENSE.txt (BSD-3-Clause); FastThaiG2P does not record the exact TLTK source release/commit

packages.name: pythainlp
packages.excluded_unused_corpus_assets: All non-Python corpus files except words_th.txt, stopwords_th.txt and corpus_license.md

publication_gate: Run the source-filtering build against the pinned FastThaiG2P commit; record retained Wiktionary/manual/generated counts and verify all runtime ipa.json entries have source metadata.
Include Wiktionary/Kaikki attribution, CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL notices; publish the filtered dictionary data under the applicable share-alike terms and provide a transparent copy.

Verify the exact TLTK version/release from which the six fallback assets and vendored parser code were copied; reconcile the PyPI BSD-3 metadata with the repository's additional LGPL-3 LICENSE file and retain all applicable notices.
Include FastThaiG2P Apache-2.0, PyThaiNLP Apache-2.0, CC0 corpus notices, tzdata Apache-2.0, Pyodide MPL-2.0 and the TLTK license texts in the browser distribution.
Set redistribution_approved to true only after the exact bundle's file manifest and attribution/license review are complete.
notes: The browser compatibility and parity tests may use ephemeral CI wheels; this does not grant public redistribution permission.

The build now removes the upstream model-generated IPA entries from the browser wheel; it retains only per-entry Wiktionary and manual source labels, with the custom tokenizer wordlist reduced to the same retained keys. OOV fallback remains enabled.
GitHub Pages deployment must remain gated while redistribution_approved is false.
No linguistic accuracy or independent IPA gold claim follows from this manifest.
